favourite.heading: Why James Madison can pull away
bullets: James Madison is the better football team by 8.5 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-8.5 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours James Madison by 1.0 points: ball control vs front disruption (-1.0 pts).

underdog.heading: Why San Diego State can keep it close
bullets: Playing at San Diego State is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 1.0 points to San Diego State (+1.0 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -27.3 to p90 +16.7 for San Diego State, so a projection of -4.3 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.

The market disagrees by 5.8 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.
